# Data exploration

## Set up

Load libraries.
```{r}
#| label: load libraries
library(sf)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)
library(exactextractr)
library(ggplot2)
library(munsell)
library(mapview)
library(units)
```

Source script with utility functions for this step.

```{r}    
#| label: source functions
source(here::here("inc/landcover-functions.R"))
```

Define the root folder for this repository and work with relative paths:

```{r}    
#| label: root path
here::i_am("indicator/download.qmd")
```

## Import the spatial data

Here we run an example of the steps of data exploation from one region. In a previous step we defined 20 regions of interest based on the Area of Occupancy grid.

Here we focus on the following region:

```{r}
#| label: selection
slc_code <- 5
```

First we read the AOO grid vector and filter to the unit of interest 
```{r}
#| label: read AOO data
slc_aoo <- st_read(
    here::here("gisdata/TEC/Swamps-Fleurieu-IM_AOO.gpkg")) |> 
    filter(id %in% slc_code)
```


The working name for this region of interest is:

```{r}
#| label: show AOO data 
st_drop_geometry(slc_aoo)
```


Now we read the indicative map and crop the polygons to the region of interest:
```{r}
slc_imap <- st_read(
    here::here("gisdata/TEC/Swamps-Fleurieu-IM.gpkg")) |> 
    st_transform(st_crs(slc_aoo)) |>
    st_crop(slc_aoo)

```

This region has several patches with areas between 4 and 42 hectars:

```{r}
slc_imap |>
    transmute(SHAPE_Area, calc_area=set_units(st_area(SHAPE),'ha')) |>
    st_drop_geometry()

```

Now we read the time series of landcover maps from the GeoTiff file, this raster has multiple bands, each representing a different year from 1988 to 2024:

```{r}
#| label: load data
raster_file <- sprintf("gisdata/landcover/lc-cell-id-%s.tif", slc_code)
r0 <- rast(here::here(raster_file))
names(r0) <- 1988:2024
```

We reproject the vector data to match the Coordinate Reference System of the raster data.
```{r}
#| label: reproject vectors
slc_imap <- st_transform(slc_imap,st_crs(r0))
slc_aoo <- st_transform(slc_aoo,st_crs(r0))
```

## Visualise the spatial data

This plot let's us confirm that the spatial extent matches the location of the grid cell:
```{r}
#| label: confirm location matches
plot(r0,1)
plot(st_geometry(slc_aoo),add=TRUE,col=NA, border="red", lwd=2)
plot(st_geometry(slc_imap),add=TRUE,border="red", lwd=4)
```

We can also explore the data interactively:
Here we focus on this region of the Fleurieu Peninsula:
```{r}
#| label: map of the cell
mapview(slc_aoo) + mapview(slc_imap) + mapview(r0)
```

## Extracting time series data per region

Now we can extract the land cover information for the whole gridcell 

```{r}
#| label: extract land cover data ROI
#| eval: true
qry_aoo <- exact_extract(r0, slc_aoo)
names(qry_aoo) <- slc_aoo$id
```

We use our custom function `code2lc` to convert the land cover codes into the corresponding classes, vegetation types and cover levels. 

```{r}
#| eval: true
res <- code2lc(qry_aoo, as.character(1988:2024))
slice_sample(res,n=5)
```

We can summarise and plot the results by year and class:

```{r}
#| eval: true
res |> 
    group_by(class,year) |> 
    summarise(total=sum(count), .groups="drop") |>
    ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=class)) + 
        geom_area()
```

Or using the vegetation type:
```{r}
#| eval: false
res |> 
    group_by(vegetation,year) |> 
    summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
    ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=vegetation)) + 
        geom_area()
```


## Extracting time series data per polygon
Now we can extract the land cover information for the whole gridcell and indicative map polygons within this area:

```{r}
#| label: extract land cover data
#| eval: true
qry_imap <- exact_extract(r0, slc_imap)
names(qry_imap) <- rownames(slc_imap)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
res <- code2lc(qry_imap, as.character(1988:2024))
res |> 
    group_by(class,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=class)) + 
    geom_area()
```

```{r}
res |> group_by(vegetation,class,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, alpha=class,fill=vegetation)) + 
    geom_area()
```


```{r}
#| eval: true
clrs <- c(
    mnsl(sapply(0:3, lighter, col = "5R 4/8")),
    mnsl(sapply(0:3, darker, col = "5BG 7/4"))
    )

grouped_res <- res |> 
    mutate(
        vegetation = factor(vegetation, levels=c("Herbaceous","Woody","none")),
        cover = factor(cover, levels=c("Sparse (4 to 15 %)","Open (15 to 40 %)","Open (40 to 65 %)","Closed (> 65 %)","none")),
        vegcover=interaction(vegetation,cover, drop=TRUE,lex.order = TRUE)) |> 
        filter(class %in% c("Natural Terrestrial Vegetated", "Cultivated Terrestrial Vegetated")) |>
        group_by(class,patch,vegcover,year) |> 
        summarise(total=sum(count), .groups="drop")

ggplot(grouped_res, aes(x=year, y=total, fill=vegcover)) + 
    geom_area() + scale_fill_manual(values=clrs) +
    facet_grid(patch ~ class) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
```
